description: Mark the household away from home (a trip, the cabin) from date to endDate. Planned dinners on unlocked days in the span are taken off the plan — unless cooksThere is true: then the household cooks where it is going, the days are planned as usual, marked as travelling, and everything for them is bought.

cooksThere.description: True when the household cooks dinner where it is going (the cabin): the days are planned and shopped for in full. Omit or false for no home dinner while away.

date.description: First day away, ISO date. A trip lies ahead: take a bare weekday from the context line's 'nearest weekday ahead' field, never from a day marked '(past)'.

endDate.description: Last day away, ISO date; omit for a single day. Never earlier than 'date' — a span runs forwards from its first day.

name: mark_away
title: Mark away from home
